description: This file defines the Mail class within the Goteo project, responsible for composing, validating, sending, and managing email messages, including handling email metadata, templates, attachments, and communication with external mail services like PHPMailer.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Represents an email message within the Goteo system, providing functionalities for composing, validating, sending, and managing email metadata, attachments, templates, and related communication details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Mail object, setting default properties based on configurations and email status.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender object if sender_id is specified.

methods.name: setPhpMailer
methods.description: Configures the PHPMailer instance based on system transport settings.

methods.name: logger
methods.description: Logs messages and errors to the system logger.

methods.name: setReply
methods.description: Sets the reply-to email and name.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the email subject.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject, loading from template if necessary.

methods.name: getReply
methods.description: Returns the reply-to email address.

methods.name: getReplyName
methods.description: Returns the reply-to name.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Associates a message ID or object with the email.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a Mail instance from the database by ID.

methods.name: getFromMessageId
methods.description: Fetches a Mail instance by message ID.

methods.name: getFromCommunicationId
methods.description: Fetches email(s) by communication ID and optional language.

methods.name: createFromText
methods.description: Creates a simple text-based email object.

methods.name: createFromHtml
methods.description: Creates an HTML email object.

methods.name: createFromTemplate
methods.description: Creates an email object from a template with variables and optional language.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates email fields like recipient, subject, and content.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the email, respecting limits and handling errors.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs and configures a PHPMailer message object.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Generates an encoded token for email tracking and URL linking.

methods.name: encodeToken
methods.description: Encodes email-related data into a token string.

methods.name: decodeToken
methods.description: Decodes and validates token string back into data.

methods.name: bodyText
methods.description: Returns the plain text version of the email content.

methods.name: bodyHTML
methods.description: Returns the HTML version of the email content with tracking links.

methods.name: renderEmailTemplate
methods.description: Renders email content using the project's templating engine with optional link processing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persist email metadata and content references into the database.

methods.name: attachFile
methods.description: Adds an attachment file to the email.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Returns stats collector related to the email.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Retrieves the sender profile associated with this email.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current mailing status.

methods.name: getStatusObject
methods.description: Returns the status as an object.

methods.name: getSentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sent emails with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: checkLimit
methods.description: Checks if sending limit has been reached for the day.

methods.name: checkBlocked
methods.description: Determines if an email is blocked due to bounces or complaints.

methods.name: removeBlocked
methods.description: Removes an email from the blocked list.

methods.name: addBounce
methods.description: Marks an email as bounced and blocks future sends if specified.

methods.name: addComplaint
methods.description: Marks an email as a complaint and blocks future sends.
